feature_stage_bundle_contract.failed_bundle_policy: Preserve its planned row with actual terminal provenance; driver produces explicit build-failed graph and missing evidence. Do not convert missing inputs into failed bundles.

interface_limitations: Current graph builder does not consume image boxes/polygons. It needs construction metric entities; no image-to-3D adapter is implemented here.
Distinct destination patches on one support must not collapse into one undifferentiated target object.
Current swept-workspace proxy uses robot-to-manipulated-object anchor when resolved; it does not certify the full object-to-destination transport segment.
Public feature payload filter prohibits hidden/evaluation fields and role_refs. Public construction IDs must never be sourced from a hidden identity mapping.
next_action: Supply a specifically audited public construction root/manifest with real terminal outcomes and metric role/region evidence, then implement a content-preserving association adapter. Do not run the feature stage on these request rows.
optional_evidence_missingness: Missing checks must remain None/empty with indicators. Missing measurements do not justify fabricated favorable values or fabricated build failures.

required_inputs.frame_state_consistency: Public evidence that the construction state supports the query's reference-frame instances, without assuming consistency across capture times.
required_inputs.hashed_population_manifest: A hashed manifest with freeze_id and exactly 72 rows keyed by freeze_id, scene_id, task_id, condition_id.
required_inputs.metric_scene: For complete builds: scene_id, objects with construction-local id/label/metric aabb, robot.base_pos, and any declared policy cameras with id/pos/look_at in the same validated frame.
required_inputs.policy_camera_and_robot_frame: Public metric robot alignment and policy-camera identity/view specification; capture intrinsics/poses alone do not establish these.
required_inputs.query_to_construction_association: Per query-condition public association from the immutable reference RGB roles/regions to construction entities; missing or ambiguous roles stay unresolved.
required_inputs.registered_public_roots: Explicitly audited public construction roots; no legacy/oracle/GT/evaluation paths.
required_inputs.resolved_freeze_id: A concrete common freeze_id instead of inherit.
required_inputs.target_region_geometry: Distinct metric placement patches or receptacle interiors grounded from public construction evidence; a shared tabletop entity alone cannot distinguish its different target patches.
required_inputs.terminal_build_provenance: Per scene-condition terminal outcome from a real construction attempt. Do not call an unattempted/missing build failed.
